description: Report indexes that cost writes and return nothing. Finds two indexes on exactly the same columns, a shorter index whose columns are a leading prefix of a longer one and which the longer already answers, and a second copy of the primary key. Also reports a unique index leading with a nullable column, which permits many null rows in most engines and therefore does not constrain what a caller may assume it does. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

ddl.description: The schema, including its CREATE INDEX statements. SQL text, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 statements. CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE and DROP INDEX, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, GRANT and REVOKE are read; anything else is listed in not_examined rather than guessed at. No database is contacted and no rows are read, so an arbitrary schema can be audited with no credential and no grant.

name: sql_index_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

efficient.description: True only when no redundant index was found and everything was read.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
